title: San Leandro ballot, model by model
description: Three independent live-web attempts per model on a representative San Leandro ballot for November 3, 2026. Compare Codex and OpenRouter models, including Grok, across 15 selectable policy axes with votes, sources, and scoring rules.

assessment.guidance: Inspect simulated ballot judgments and evidence. Economic/social coordinates are response self-assessments; additional axes descriptively code measure votes using visible rules. Neither is a validated ideology test or model identity.
